productDirection: Limited funded pilot using existing promotional credits; unverified renewal is not a blocker and no unfunded monthly commitment is made.
accountingUnit: integer microUSD, with usage and reservations rounded up

fundingBasis.fundingSource: Current Product direction; no independent account probe performed by this proposal author.

proposedPolicy.effectiveExpiryRule: Earlier of the stated upper bound and independently verified API-key expiry.

activationConditions: Separate coordinated activation after applicable database, authorization, credential and release gates; this receipt does not enable inference.
Freeze independent local spending before transferring its latest journal into the shared meter; preserve the local $5 cap until cutover.
Under the shared policy-row lock, reconcile the latest local carryover monotonically and compute A = legacy_accounted_microusd + SUM(COALESCE(actual_microusd,reserved_microusd)).
Authorize the new $4 allowance only if A + 4000000 <= 5000000 and currently usable credits cover $4 plus unresolved-charge allowances and a conservative reserve.
For the stated last accepted journal with no shared rows or uncertainty, A = 539956 and the proposed cumulative ceiling is 4539956 microUSD.
If actual spend or uncertainty has advanced, stop and reconcile the limits and funding bound before activation; do not silently reset history or increase the cap.
Preserve all usage and uncertain reservations, imported carryover, current call limits and Qwen fallback; do not auto-release unresolved outcomes.
No automatic renewal, November budget increase, payment-method change, credit purchase or recharge. Funding expiry ends this pilot policy; Qwen remains available.

validationBoundary.reason: It requires a dedicated empty tenbot_meter_test_* database and resets all app_users activity and app_role_capabilities in its own disposable fixture. Do not relax these guards or run its resets against shared permission fixtures.
validationBoundary.meterVerifierEvidenceLimit: Actual PostgreSQL role and metering execution only when run against an explicitly disposable database; minimal app tables and SET ROLE do not certify signed JWT, real Supabase Auth or Job RLS.
remainingRealHistoryCases: Employee/admin cross-user claim, clear and raw-history access denial.
Privileged load/commit RPC denial, owner/claim/revision mismatch and replay.
Concurrent claims, expiry takeover, clear versus commit and permission revocation.
Nonrenewing hydration, bounded retention and legacy fallback revision release.
remainingHttpAuthorizationCases: Real signed-token authentication, expired/invalid token denial and inactive/revoked account denial.
Actual caller-authorized Job reads and protected-record RLS.
